## [CN]评分如何计算头文件
## [EN]How the score counts a header

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `scripts/swift-migration-score.py`：只要头文件中有一行不是宏、`#import`、注释或 Swift 兼容标记，整个头文件都算 Objective-C。带有 `CYL-SWIFT-MIGRATION: objc-required` 标记（并写明原因）的文件算作兼容：用于 Swift 无法为 Objective-C 调用方表达的内容。 | `scripts/swift-migration-score.py`: a header counts as Objective-C as a whole as soon as one line is not a macro, an `#import`, a comment or a Swift compatibility marker. A file marked `CYL-SWIFT-MIGRATION: objc-required` (with the reason) counts as compatible: it is for what Swift cannot express for Objective-C callers. |

## [CN]Swift 能表达与不能表达的内容
## [EN]What Swift can and cannot express

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| **可以移到 Swift**（Objective-C 通过生成的接口看到，名称不变）：类、类别（Swift 扩展）、`NS_ENUM` 整数枚举（`@objc enum …: Int` / `UInt`，case 名称与导入的名称相同）、协议（`@objc protocol`，可选方法、类方法 `static func`、属性的 getter / setter 名称用 `@objc(name)`）、C 函数（`@_cdecl`，生成的接口会声明它）。 | **Can move to Swift** (Objective-C sees it through the generated interface, same names): classes, categories (Swift extensions), `NS_ENUM` integer enums (`@objc enum …: Int` / `UInt`, case names equal to the imported ones), protocols (`@objc protocol`, optional methods, class methods as `static func`, getter / setter names of properties with `@objc(name)`), C functions (`@_cdecl`, declared by the generated interface). |
| **不能移到 Swift**（保留在带 `objc-required` 标记的小头文件中）：`NS_OPTIONS`（Swift 的 `OptionSet` 不能导出到 Objective-C）：`CYLImageLoadOptions`、`CYLTabBarReselectBehavior`；Objective-C 源码使用其名称的 block `typedef`（Swift 的 `typealias` 不会导出，App 中写 `CYLViewDidLayoutSubViewsBlock block` 的代码会无法编译）；`NS_TYPED_EXTENSIBLE_ENUM` 字符串类型 `CYLTabBarAnimationOption`；带编译警告属性（`CYL_LOTTIE_REQUIRED` 等，AGENTS.md）的动画键；宏中使用的内联函数可以改为 `@_cdecl` 函数加宏。 | **Cannot move to Swift** (kept in small headers marked `objc-required`): `NS_OPTIONS` (a Swift `OptionSet` cannot be exported to Objective-C): `CYLImageLoadOptions`, `CYLTabBarReselectBehavior`; block `typedef`s whose names Objective-C source uses (a Swift `typealias` is not exported, so app code writing `CYLViewDidLayoutSubViewsBlock block` would stop compiling); the `NS_TYPED_EXTENSIBLE_ENUM` string type `CYLTabBarAnimationOption`; the animation keys with their compile-warning attributes (`CYL_LOTTIE_REQUIRED` …, AGENTS.md); inline functions used by macros can become `@_cdecl` functions plus macros; and methods whose block parameters use `__kindof` (the generated header prints the block type expanded, without `__kindof`, so Objective-C blocks with a narrower parameter type stop compiling: the theme providers, step 116). |

## [CN]一起修改的头文件分组
## [EN]Groups of headers that change together

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 一个协议或枚举移到 Swift 时，所有在声明中使用它的 Objective-C 头文件必须在同一次修改中去掉这些声明（Objective-C 头文件不能使用 Swift 的协议或枚举，2026-11-13 的实验）。下表按使用关系分组（`scripts` 外的一次性扫描，2026-11-19）。**不依赖 `CYLTabBarController.h` 的分组可以在类切换之前单独完成**；其余分组与 `CYLTabBarController.h` 一起，在类切换之后的同一次修改中完成。 | When a protocol or an enum moves to Swift, every Objective-C header that uses it in a declaration must drop those declarations in the same change (an Objective-C header cannot use a Swift protocol or enum, experiment of 2026-11-13). The table groups them by use (a one-off scan, 2026-11-19). **Groups that do not depend on `CYLTabBarController.h` can be done on their own, before the class switch**; the others go with `CYLTabBarController.h`, in one change after the class switch. |

## [CN]Package.swift：一个 Swift target
## [EN]Package.swift: one Swift target

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 类切换与第 ③ 阶段之后：`CYLTabBarController` target 改为纯 Swift（`Swift/`、`CYLUtils/Swift`、`CYLBadgeView/Swift`、`CYLTabBarItemAnimation/Swift`、`CYLFlatDesignTabBar-ObjectiveC/Swift`），资源为 `Resources/CYLTabBarController.bundle`；`objc-required` 头文件放入一个只有头文件的 C 语言 target（SwiftPM 允许 Swift target 依赖 C/Objective-C target，反过来不行），Swift target 依赖它；`CYLAnimatedItem` 保持独立 target。草稿在第 ③ 阶段提交前写入本节，并用三个 SwiftPM 示例（`Example-Swift-Gallery`、`Example-Swift-SwiftManager`、`-FlatDesign`）验证。 | After the class switch and phase ③: the `CYLTabBarController` target becomes pure Swift (`Swift/`, `CYLUtils/Swift`, `CYLBadgeView/Swift`, `CYLTabBarItemAnimation/Swift`, `CYLFlatDesignTabBar-ObjectiveC/Swift`) with `Resources/CYLTabBarController.bundle`; the `objc-required` headers go into a header-only C-language target (SwiftPM lets a Swift target depend on a C / Objective-C target, not the other way round), which the Swift target depends on; `CYLAnimatedItem` stays its own target. The draft goes into this section before the phase ③ commit, verified with the three SwiftPM demos (`Example-Swift-Gallery`, `Example-Swift-SwiftManager`, `-FlatDesign`). |
